profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Threads profiles to scrape, one per line, as @handle or profile URL (https://www.threads.com/@zuck). Each profile yields one profile record plus up to 'Maximum posts per profile' of its newest posts.

maxPostsPerProfile.title: Maximum posts per profile
maxPostsPerProfile.description: How many of the newest posts to collect from each profile (the Actor paginates automatically).

postUrls.title: Post URLs
postUrls.description: Individual Threads post URLs (https://www.threads.com/@user/post/CODE), one per line. Each yields the post itself and, optionally, its replies.

includeReplies.title: Include replies for post URLs
includeReplies.description: For each post URL, also save the reply posts shown on the post page (about 20 top replies, logged-out view). Each reply is a separate post record.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on Threads, one per line. Each query returns the first page of results (about 20 posts) that Threads shows to visitors without an account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Enabled by default; the Actor rotates the proxy session every 15 requests.

profilePostsDocId.title: Advanced: GraphQL doc_id for profile pagination
profilePostsDocId.description: Only change this if profile pagination stops working after a Threads web update. The value is the doc_id of Threads' BarcelonaProfileThreadsTabRefetchableDirectQuery for logged-out visitors.
